login.title: Connect with Anchor
login.body: Scan with Anchor on your mobile device or click the button below to open on this device.

mode.title: How do you use Anchor?
mode.body: Choose where to approve requests. You can choose differently the next time you log in.

switch.to_web: Use Anchor in this browser instead

recovery.title: Request cancelled
recovery.body: Choose how you want to try again.

waiting.title: Approve in Anchor
waiting.body: Please approve this in the Anchor window.

blocked.title: Pop-up blocked
blocked.body: Pop-up blocked by your browser. Open the Anchor window manually.
blocked.label: Open Anchor

transact.title: Complete using Anchor
transact.body: Please open your Anchor Wallet on "{{channelName}}" to review and approve this transaction.
transact.label: Sign manually or with another device

error.expired: The request expired, please try again.
error.invalid_response: Invalid response from Anchor, must contain link_ch, link_key, link_name and cid flags.
error.cancelled: The request was cancelled from Anchor.
